svg.title: Microservices architecture diagram
svg.desc: Microservices decomposition showing edge/frontend tier, backend services (all launched from shared Docker image with different entrypoints), async messaging via RabbitMQ, and shared infrastructure: MongoDB, time-series DBs, log pipeline, secrets.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does nginx do as an edge proxy in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does Traefik do as ingress?')
sendPrompt('What do the ui, landing, and portal frontend apps serve?')

g.text: Backend services — image: api:$IMG_TAG, different entrypoints

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the api service do — bin/uwsgi entrypoint?')
sendPrompt('What does api-v2 add over api — OpenAPI?')
sendPrompt('What does the sockjs service do?')
sendPrompt('What does the sheller service do?')
sendPrompt('What does the dramatiq service do — bin/dramatiq?')
sendPrompt('What does the scheduler service do — APScheduler?')
sendPrompt('What does the poller service do — bin/poller?')
sendPrompt('How does RabbitMQ enable async messaging between services?')
g.text: Async decoupling between api/scheduler/poller producers and dramatiq workers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do the microservices share MongoDB as a primary data store?')
g.text: All backend services read/write via HTTP or direct connection

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does logstash do in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does Elasticsearch store in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does gocky do as a metrics relay?')
sendPrompt('What do InfluxDB and VictoriaMetrics store?')
sendPrompt('How does Vault manage secrets for services?')

svg.text: Sync: HTTP between services — Async: AMQP via RabbitMQ — Entrypoints: bin/uwsgi · bin/dramatiq · bin/sockjs · bin/scheduler · bin/poller
